papers.title: Collusion with Competitive Marginals: Price-Level Audits Are Blind by Construction
papers.titleZh: 具有竞争性边际的共谋：价格水平审计本质上是盲目的
papers.abstract: Empirical work on algorithmic collusion asks one question of the data: are prices supracompetitive? We show this can be answered "no" by a conspiracy that is nonetheless profitable. Consider bidding agents that couple only through the joint distribution of their unexplained bid components, leaving every agent's own bid law exactly at the competitive law. Any test whose input is a single agent's price or bid history then has power exactly equal to its false-positive rate, for every coupling strength up to comonotonicity. The published detection methodology is therefore blind to this conduct by construction rather than underpowered, and no sample size repairs it. Three empirical results follow. First, the mechanism appears in real language-model agents: twenty models from nineteen independent developers, three deployment prompts each, show residual correlation of $+0.053$ between two deployments of one model against $+0.0001$ across models, with a 95% interval clustered by developer of $[0.030, 0.078]$, under an auditor that sees every order feature and is fitted out of sample. Second, the coupling falls monotonically as sampling temperature rises ($p=0.002$), turning a deployment parameter into a candidate mitigation. Third, on 24 days of Ethereum block-building auction data covering 77,684 bids from 39 bidders, the honest population of bidder pairs is itself so dependent that a screen held at a 5% false-positive rate must sit above a floor of $+0.50$ to $+0.81$, which is 20 to 32 times the family-wise sampling threshold and does not fall as the audit window grows. Since lawful multi-identity operation and conspiracy are behaviourally indistinguishable here, the tractable regulatory target is not detection but counting: resolving 40 bidding identities into 23 operators raises the Herfindahl index by 247.5%, and adding behavioural clusters from public bid streams reaches 324.5%.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有算法共谋研究依赖于检测价格是否高于竞争水平，但本文指出这种范式存在根本盲区：即使价格始终符合竞争分布，多个代理仍可通过协调出价中的不可解释成分来系统性压低卖家收入。问题核心在于，传统审计无法识别仅通过联合分布（而非边际变化）实现的隐蔽合谋，这挑战了以价格信号为核心的监管逻辑。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定为多轮拍卖，每个代理的出价由可观测特征解释部分和残差项组成，后者服从固定边际分布。共谋不改变任何单个代理的边际出价分布，仅通过调整残差项之间的相依结构（copula）实现协调。关键假设是共享随机源（如公共数据或相同基础模型），使代理间无需通信即可产生相关行为，从而最小化最高出价的期望值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，只要边际分布不变，任何基于单个代理价格历史的检验都无法区分竞争与共谋，其检验功效恒等于显著性水平。实证发现真实语言模型代理在相同基础模型下存在显著残差相关性，且该相关性随采样温度升高而减弱。此外，在以太坊区块竞拍数据中，合法多身份操作与共谋的行为痕迹无法区分，导致检测下限远高于抽样误差。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造共享伪随机函数下的联合分布实现零通信耦合，并利用超模序下共单调耦合最小化最大值的性质，证明卖方收益下降。技术核心在于区分边缘分布与联合结构的作用。仿真验证单边检验完全失效，而配对检验有效；实证部分采用交叉拟合回归提取残差，结合聚类置信区间评估相关性，确保结果不受过拟合影响。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文局限在于实体识别依赖赢标记录，未赢标者无法标注，限制长期面板分析；且语言模型实验与链上数据属不同系统，结论为论证性组合而非直接因果。最值得读的是其对‘检测不可能性’的清晰建模，以及从‘识别共谋’转向‘统计独立决策者数量’的监管范式转换建议，这对AI驱动市场的治理具有深远启示。

papers.title: The Computable but Not Learnable Information-Value-Free Equilibria and Regulation of Algorithmic Collusion
papers.titleZh: 可计算但不可学习的信息价值自由均衡与算法共谋监管
papers.abstract: A correlated equilibrium is information-value-free if every player has an action that yields the same payoff as their equilibrium strategy when all other players follow their respective equilibrium strategies. An equilibrium is learnable if the empirical history of play generated by certain learning algorithms using only full feedback on each player's own payoff converges to it. Our main result is that although an information-value-free equilibrium can be computed efficiently offline, it is not learnable by a broad class of learning algorithms. This separation stands in sharp contrast to canonical equilibrium concepts, where offline computation and online learning typically have comparable difficulty. In information-economics terms, our results imply that learning correlated equilibria in games cannot avoid generating valuable information, which has implications for current debates on the regulation of algorithmic collusion: Valuable and implicit information exchange is unavoidable under rationalizable learning, and traditional antitrust regulation against such exchange is therefore incompatible with rationalizable learning. Our results also imply an informational impossibility result for time-average convergence to a Nash equilibrium by a broad class of learning algorithms.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 本文探讨理性学习过程中是否必然产生有价值的信息交换。在算法定价广泛应用的背景下，监管机构试图禁止算法间的隐性沟通以防共谋，但作者指出，若学习算法要有效适应环境并优化自身行为，则无法避免生成可被利用的信息。问题核心在于：追求效率的学习过程是否会内生出监管所担忧的协调通道？这挑战了当前基于‘通信禁令’的反垄断政策逻辑。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑两个玩家重复进行阶段博弈，各自采用仅依赖自身收益反馈的无耦合学习算法。信息价值自由均衡（IVFE）要求既是相关均衡，又使每个玩家无法通过单方面偏离到固定动作而获益。该设定下，学习动态的经验证据分布是否收敛至IVFE，取决于算法能否同时满足无swap后悔和非负事后最优后悔，从而捕捉学习过程中信息利用与价值生成的关系。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明尽管IVFE可在多项式时间内离线计算，但它无法被一大类平滑学习算法在线学会——即经验分布始终与IVFE保持一定距离。这一分离结果表明，理性可辩护的学习必然生成有价值信息。作为推论，纳什均衡的时间平均收敛对这类算法也是不可能的，揭示了一种新型的信息性障碍而非计算复杂性障碍。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造对抗性游戏序列来证明不可能性：一个平滑学习者的行为被设计为缓慢响应微小收益差异，从而迫使对手在不同阶段面临冲突的激励。分析结合了swap后悔与事后最优后悔的联合约束，并利用线性规划刻画IVFE，最终通过精细的累积后悔分解展示学习动态无法同时满足两项要求，从而建立信息生成的必然性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于‘平滑学习’这一特定算法类别，排除了突变式策略更新机制。虽然不涵盖所有学习动态，但其揭示的学习与信息之间的根本张力极具启发性。最值得阅读的是其对‘理性学习’本质的重新审视，以及为算法监管提供的信息经济学视角，特别是关于为何抑制信息流动可能损害市场竞争效率的深刻洞见。

papers.title: Stable and Budget-Feasible Coalition Formation for Clustered Federated Learning: A Hedonic Potential-Game Approach
papers.titleZh: 面向聚类联邦学习的稳定且预算可行的联盟形成：一种享乐势博弈方法
papers.abstract: Clustered federated learning benefits from organizing heterogeneous participants into coalitions that train coalition-specific models, but such clustering is sustainable only if participants prefer their assigned coalition and the required transfers are affordable. We develop a transferable-surplus model separating learning benefit, system cost, participant cost, and monetary transfers; an allocation rule converts coalition surplus into hedonic preferences, and weak budget feasibility guarantees nonnegative retained coordinator surplus. For symmetric pairwise allocations the induced game is an exact potential game: a Nash-stable partition exists, every strict better-response process converges, and with destination consent accepted better responses reach an individually stable partition. We characterize feasibility of bounded pair incentives and verify the exponentially many budget constraints in polynomial oracle time when retained slack is submodular. Decomposing welfare into participant potential and retained slack yields additive and multiplicative price-of-stability guarantees, the latter asymptotically tight; exact balance gives welfare-optimal stability only on the pairwise-representable class, and budget feasibility alone permits unbounded welfare loss. Global potential maximization equals weighted maximum-agreement correlation clustering, and approximation followed by stabilization satisfies an end-to-end welfare bound governed by retained slack and negative-edge mass, attained by an explicit construction. In a preregistered five-seed CIFAR-10 study the mechanism reaches the certified estimated-table welfare optimum on every primary instance, equal-surplus sharing has no Nash-stable outcome on three, and pairwise validation gain gives far more reliable pair signs than gradient alignment.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 联邦学习中参与者异质性强，全局协作可能损害个体收益，需通过分组建模提升统计效率。然而，如何激励参与者加入并稳定留在联盟，同时确保协调方支付转移不超预算，仍是经济与战略上的挑战。本文聚焦于联盟形成的稳定性与预算可行性之间的张力，追问：能否设计出既经济合理又可实现稳定配置的分配机制？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定中，每个参与者拥有本地数据，联盟共同训练一个专属模型并产生可转移剩余。协调方设计基于成对价值的分配规则，参与者据此形成偏好并决定是否迁移联盟。个体效用由所获转移减去参与成本决定，协调方保留非负盈余以满足弱预算可行性。稳定性采用纳什稳定与个体稳定两种标准，前者允许自由加入，后者要求目的地成员同意。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明对称成对分配机制诱导出精确势博弈，从而保证纳什稳定划分的存在性与严格响应动态的有限收敛性。进一步地，协调方保留的预算松弛可量化稳定解与社会最优间的福利差距，相对松弛下界紧致。特别地，精确预算平衡时可在特定剩余类上实现福利最优稳定解，而仅预算可行则可能导致无界损失。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心技术是构造一个与个体效用变化完全一致的全局势函数，将稳定划分的存在性归约为势函数的最大化问题。通过将全局优化等价于加权最大一致相关聚类，作者导出近似后稳定的端到端福利界。子模性假设下的松弛验证可在多项式时间内完成，关键在于利用子模函数最小化的高效算法处理指数级约束。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设协调方完全知晓各联盟的价值与成本，未考虑私有类型申报与激励相容性，限制了其在真实场景中的直接应用。实验仅在小规模（n=4）与单一任务（CIFAR-10）上验证，难以推广至大规模系统。但其将联盟稳定性、预算控制与效率损失联系起来的理论框架极具启发性，最值得阅读的是其势函数构造、效率界分析及对分配机制设计的深刻洞察。

papers.title: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
papers.titleZh: 在可检测性的边缘进行后训练：一种基于博弈论的微调方法
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning is widely used in language model training to improve model performance on a target task while limiting drift from a reference policy. A standard way to balance this trade-off is via a KL-regularized RL objective, although this formulation does not by itself provide a principled way to set the regularization coefficient. In practice, the coefficient is typically chosen heuristically or via hyperparameter search, which can lead to unnecessary overhead in training cost or undesirable reward-retention trade-offs. We instead propose a game-theoretic framework that gives this trade-off an explicit statistical interpretation. Specifically, we study a sequential game in which an agent chooses a policy to maximize cumulative reward while a monitor observes policy outputs over time and tests for deviations from the reference policy. Although not originating from the same perspective, we show that the resulting equilibrium policy can nonetheless be expressed as the solution to a KL-regularized RL problem for an optimal regularization parameter that can be viewed as maximizing reward per unit of statistical distinguishability. Drawing on classical results from concave-convex fractional programming, we provide a principled method for learning this equilibrium coefficient via reduction to the KL-regularized RL objective, thus allowing for flexible integration into standard fine-tuning pipelines. In experiments with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-1B, we demonstrate that our methods result in competitive reward-retention trade-offs in a continual learning setting, and illustrate how our framework may be used to audit API providers serving open-source models.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么不能随意微调大模型？因为既要提升任务性能，又要防止行为偏离原始模型，即所谓‘对齐税’问题。传统方法通过KL正则平衡奖励与偏离，但正则系数需手动调整，缺乏原则性依据。本文从检测视角重构该问题：如果一个监控者能通过输出序列发现模型已被微调，则部署将被终止。这引出根本问题：在不被察觉的前提下，最多能获得多少奖励增益？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 文章构建了一个序贯博弈：智能体选择策略以最大化累计奖励，而监控者持续观测输入-输出对，并执行序贯假设检验来判断是否发生策略偏移。博弈的核心在于，监控者控制第一类错误率（误报率），而智能体需在高奖励与低可检测性之间权衡。均衡下，智能体的最优策略是相对于参考策略的KL正则化倾斜，而监控者的最优检测方式是基于似然比的序贯概率比检验（SPRT）。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文最大的发现是，该博弈的纳什均衡自然导出了标准的KL正则化强化学习目标，且正则系数β*具有明确的操作意义：它最大化单位统计可区分性所带来的奖励收益。这意味着无需人为设定β，而是由奖励函数、提示分布和参考策略内生决定。此外，文章证明了即使智能体采用非唯一最优策略，监控者的SPRT仍保持有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者将求解均衡系数的问题转化为分数规划，并利用Dinkelbach算法思想将其还原为一系列KL正则化子问题。通过构造一个随机二分搜索算法（Algorithm 1），逐步逼近最优β*。关键技术结合了序贯检验中的期望停时下界与分数规划的凸凹结构，使算法仅需O(log(1/ε))次子问题求解即可达到ε精度，且可嵌入现有微调流程。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖于监控者能访问参考策略和奖励函数的设定，在黑盒审计场景中可能受限。此外，理论分析集中在高置信极限（α→0），实际有限样本下的收敛速度有待进一步验证。尽管如此，本文的价值在于提供了微调超参数的全新博弈语义解释，并展示了如何将理论均衡转化为实用算法，其框架对模型审计、抗蒸馏等应用亦具启发性。

papers.title: Sensitivity and Differential Privacy in Metric Voting with Distortion below Three
papers.titleZh: 在失真低于三的度量投票中研究敏感性和微分隐私
papers.abstract: Voting rules aggregate individual preferences into collective decisions, but the rankings they receive contain only ordinal information. The metric distortion framework studies ordinal voting rules in settings where voters and candidates are embedded in an unknown metric space. Deterministic rules have optimal worst-case distortion $3$, while recent randomized rules break the $3$ barrier. We study whether such improvements can coexist with low worst-case sensitivity with respect to the Wasserstein distance of lotteries under one-voter deletion and approximate differential privacy under one-voter replacement. On the sensitivity side, we give a randomized rule with distortion at most $3-\varepsilon$ for an absolute constant $\varepsilon>0$ and, for $m$ candidates and $n$ voters, a worst-case sensitivity bound of $O((\log m+1)/n)$. On the privacy side, for every $δ\in(0,1)$ and all $n$ above an absolute constant, we construct a variant rule whose mechanism releasing a single sampled winner has distortion at most $3-\varepsilon$ and is $(O((\log m+\log(1/δ)+1)/n),δ)$-differentially private. Both constructions use the same family of Gibbs distributions over constant-size candidate lists, with only the temperature parameter differing between the sensitivity and differential-privacy guarantees. Our analysis builds on the biased-metric viewpoint behind the recent improvement over the $3$ barrier and proves a stability property for the biased-metric ratio.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么随机化投票规则在降低度量失真后仍需关注稳定性与隐私？现有研究表明，虽然随机化可突破确定性规则的失真下限3，但由此产生的规则可能对个体选民变化极为敏感，甚至泄露偏好信息。本文追问：是否存在一种投票机制，能在保持失真低于3的同时，具备低敏感性和差分隐私？这触及投票系统的鲁棒性与隐私保护的根本权衡。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑一个标准的社会选择场景：n位选民和m位候选人在未知度量空间中，每位选民提交对候选人的全序偏好。投票规则仅基于这些序数排名输出一个候选人彩票（即概率分布）。研究聚焦于两种扰动下的行为：删除一位选民时彩票的Wasserstein距离变化（敏感性），以及替换一位选民排名时的差分隐私保障。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文构造了一种基于吉布斯分布的新随机化投票规则，在所有偏好配置下实现了严格低于3的失真，并首次同时获得良好的敏感性与隐私保证。具体而言，该规则在单个选民删除下的最坏情况敏感性为O((log m + 1)/n)，在释放抽样胜者时满足(O((log m + log(1/δ) + 1)/n), δ)-差分隐私，接近理论下限1/n的尺度。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者的关键技术是将Cai等人关于‘有界随机性’的存在性结果转化为一个可控的机制。他们对所有常数大小候选列表赋予吉布斯权重，其中能量函数由‘偏置度量比’决定。通过分析该比率在单个选民变动下的稳定性，并结合吉布斯尾部界限，实现了对分布漂移的精细控制，从而统一处理了敏感性与隐私分析。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该机制目前是信息论上的存在性构造，因需枚举指数级列表而不具计算效率。此外，log m因子是否必要尚不明确。尽管如此，论文的价值在于提出了‘低失真+高隐私/鲁棒性’的联合目标，并展示了吉布斯机制与偏置度量框架结合的强大潜力，其稳定性分析方法对后续研究具有启发意义。

papers.title: Linguistic Monoculture in LLM-Assisted Language Use
papers.titleZh: 大型语言模型辅助下的语言单一化
papers.abstract: Writing and communication are increasingly mediated by large language models (LLMs) that are being used to draft, revise and polish text. Although such assistance can improve clarity and help authors meet institutional expectations, widespread reliance on shared models may reduce population-level variation in linguistic form, a phenomenon we refer to as linguistic monoculture. We develop a mathematical framework in which authors and LLMs are represented as distributions over linguistic features and coevolve through repeated interaction. We analyze three interaction mechanisms: a shared model with a fixed linguistic distribution, a shared model recursively updated from author outputs, and personalized models updated through author-specific and population-level feedback. We characterize the resulting equilibria and convergence rates, showing that, shared models can drive authors toward a common norm, recursive feedback relocates the shared norm without altering pairwise spread under common conformity, and personalization can preserve a family of distinct author-model equilibria with nonzero linguistic diversity. We then endogenize conformity as a strategic choice trading off private benefits from clarity, legibility, and perceived fluency against distinctive style. Within this utility model, individually rational authors may conform more than is socially optimal because they do not internalize the value their distinctiveness provides to others, creating a negative externality and a price of monoculture that is finite for each fixed instance but can grow without bound when distinctiveness dominates authenticity. Synthetic simulations illustrate how fixed shared assistance, recursive feedback, and personalization produce different long-run diversity outcomes.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）广泛用于写作辅助，人们担忧其可能导致语言表达趋同，削弱个体风格和思想多样性。尽管LLM能提升清晰度和规范性，但共享模型的普遍使用可能推动作者向统一的语言模式靠拢，形成‘语言单一化’。本文关注这一现象背后的动态机制：在不同人机交互模式下，LLM辅助是否会必然导致语言多样性丧失，还是存在保留差异性的可能路径。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究构建了一个作者与LLM共同演化的数学框架，将语言风格表示为词汇、句法等特征上的概率分布。作者通过调整自身风格来融合LLM建议，而LLM则根据作者输出递归更新其分布。设定了三种交互机制：固定共享模型、递归更新的共享模型、以及个性化递归更新模型。通过模拟作者群体在不同机制下的长期演化，衡量群体层面的语言多样性变化，核心指标为作者间风格分布的Jensen-Shannon散度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，使用固定共享模型会驱动全体作者收敛于同一语言规范，导致多样性趋零；而递归更新虽改变共享规范的位置，却不改变作者间的相对差异结构。关键发现是，个性化机制能够维持一个由多个差异化平衡点构成的稳态，从而保护语言多样性。进一步地，在将‘从众程度’建模为理性选择时，发现个体最优的从众水平高于社会最优，产生‘单一化代价’，且该代价在某些情形下可无限增长。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用动态系统建模，将语言风格演化形式化为分布间的迭代更新过程，并结合博弈论将从众行为内生化为效用最大化决策。通过分析三种机制下的收敛性与速率，揭示了共享、反馈与个性化对多样性的影响路径。在战略模型中，引入包含清晰度收益、真实性成本与独特性收益的效用函数，证明个体忽视其独特性对他人带来的正外部性，导致过度从众，这一机制与算法同质化中的社会福利损失相呼应。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设作者仅受LLM影响，忽略了现实中的多元语言输入源；且将从众偏好设为静态，未考虑动态调整。正交签名与二次效用等简化假设限制了结果的普适性。尽管如此，论文的价值在于首次形式化了LLM引发语言单一化的动态机制，并揭示了个性化作为制度设计的关键作用。最值得阅读的是其理论框架、均衡分析与战略模型，为理解AI辅助创作的社会影响提供了基础工具。

papers.title: Cost-Sensitive Conformal Prediction and Human-in-the-Loop Abstention for Imbalanced High-Stakes Decision Support: A Multi-Domain Benchmark
papers.titleZh: 面向不平衡高风险决策支持的成本敏感共形预测与人机协同弃权：一个多领域基准
papers.abstract: High-stakes decision systems in credit scoring, fraud detection, healthcare, and industrial safety require reliable uncertainty quantification under severe class imbalance and asymmetric error costs. Standard marginal conformal prediction (CP) provides valid overall coverage guarantees; however, we show that it severely under-covers rare, costly minority classes, with minority-class coverage dropping to as low as 0.5% on certain datasets. To characterize and address this limitation, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark comparing marginal CP, class-conditional (Mondrian) CP, and cost-controlled abstention mechanisms across 15 real-world imbalanced tabular datasets, 7 classification models, 3 probability calibration techniques, and 10 random seeds, resulting in 3,150 experimental runs. Our results show that Mondrian CP restores valid minority-class coverage, achieving an average minority-coverage improvement of 61.7 percentage points over marginal CP (p < 1e-80). Furthermore, combining Mondrian CP with cost-controlled abstention significantly reduces expected decision cost compared with standard decision boundaries, confidence-based rejectors, and risk-controlled rejectors under realistic human review budgets. We further quantify dataset-specific break-even thresholds at which deferring ambiguous instances to human experts becomes cost-effective. These findings provide practical guidance for deploying distribution-free, cost-aware uncertainty quantification in high-stakes decision support systems.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在信用评分、医疗诊断等高风险场景中，少数类错误（如漏诊）代价极高，但传统共形预测仅保证整体覆盖率，导致罕见类别覆盖率极低，甚至低于1%。这使得模型在关键任务中不可靠。现有方法忽视了类别不平衡下的覆盖失效问题，也未系统结合人类专家介入的成本效益分析，难以支撑实际决策系统。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在15个真实不平衡表格数据集上评估多种共形预测方法，输入为特征向量，输出为包含真实标签的预测集或触发人工审核的弃权信号。通过划分校准集计算非一致性分数，并比较边际共形预测、类条件（Mondrian）共形预测与成本控制弃权机制的表现，核心指标包括少数类覆盖率、预期决策成本和弃权率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文揭示了标准共形预测在少数类上的严重覆盖缺陷，并证明类条件Mondrian方法可将少数类覆盖率从平均30.5%提升至92.2%。进一步引入成本感知弃权机制，在合理人工审查成本下显著降低总体预期损失。结果基于3150次实验验证，提供了可操作的部署原则，改变了对高风险系统中不确定性管理的认知。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是Mondrian共形预测，其按类别分别计算非一致性分数阈值，确保每一类内部满足覆盖率要求。当预测集含多个标签或为空时，系统主动弃权并交由人类专家处理。结合误判成本与人工审查成本，推导出经济可行的‘盈亏平衡’成本阈值，指导何时弃权更划算，从而实现成本最优的决策流程。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖于静态数据假设，面对分布漂移时需动态更新阈值；极端稀疏类别下量化估计方差较大；人工错误率恒定假设可能低估认知疲劳影响。最值得阅读的是其问题设定与系统级设计，尤其是如何将理论覆盖率保障转化为实际成本节约的完整链条，对部署可靠AI系统具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret for Online Convex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.titleZh: 重尾噪声下在线凸优化的无参数动态后悔
papers.abstract: We study online convex optimization (OCO) in non-stationary environments under heavy-tailed noise, where the stochastic gradient oracle admits only a finite $p$-th central moment for some $p \in (1, 2]$. While static regret is well-understood, achieving universal dynamic regret in a parameter-free manner remains an open challenge. We resolve this by proposing \textbf{HT-PAder}, a parameter-free algorithm combining restarted AdaGrad experts over a geometric pool of block lengths with a pathwise meta-algorithm, \textbf{AdaGrad-Hedge}, which requires no moment conditions on meta-losses. For a domain of diameter $D$, Lipschitz constant $G$, noise level $σ$, and comparator path length $P_T$, HT-PAder achieves an expected universal dynamic regret of \[ \widetilde O\left( GD\sqrt{T(1+P_T/D)} + σD T^{1/p}(1+P_T/D)^{(p-1)/p} \right). \] The algorithm does not require prior knowledge of any of these problem parameters. Even in the special case of finite variance ($p=2$), HT-PAder provides the first parameter-free minimax universal dynamic regret guarantee. We also prove a matching lower bound, establishing the optimality of the path-length exponent.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统在线凸优化假设梯度噪声具有有限方差，但在深度学习等实际场景中梯度常呈重尾分布，导致经典算法失效。同时，在非平稳环境中静态后悔不再适用，需采用依赖比较序列路径长度的动态后悔。现有动态后悔算法依赖指数加权元算法，要求损失矩条件，无法兼容重尾噪声，且通常需预知问题参数，限制了实用性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在线凸优化框架下的通用动态后悔最小化问题，其中损失函数为凸且Lipschitz连续，决策域有界。环境提供仅具有限p阶中心矩（p∈(1,2]）的随机梯度，允许重尾噪声。目标是在不预知Lipschitz常数G、噪声水平σ、尾部指数p及比较序列路径长度P_T的情况下，实现对任意比较序列的自适应动态后悔上界。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出HT-PAder算法，首次实现了重尾噪声下无需参数调整的最优通用动态后悔。其期望动态后悔上界包含确定性项与噪声项，噪声项中路径长度的指数(p−1)/p被证明是最优的。特别地，当p=2时，该算法给出首个无需已知G的有限方差设置下的无参数最小最大动态后悔保证，解决了长期存在的开放问题。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 算法结合重启的AdaGrad专家与路径式元算法AdaGrad-Hedge。前者通过分块重启自适应局部梯度尺度与路径长度，后者利用自适应学习率避免对元损失矩的依赖。关键创新在于路径式分析：AdaGrad-Hedge的后悔绑定在每个样本路径上成立，从而绕过对梯度高阶矩的需求，使整个框架兼容重尾噪声并保持完全自适应性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文聚焦理论最优性，未提供实际运行时间或内存开销分析，且假设决策域直径D已知。下界证明依赖于精心构造的对抗性线性损失，现实场景中是否紧致尚待验证。最值得阅读的是其路径式元算法设计思想与对重尾噪声下动态后悔本质难度的刻画，为鲁棒自适应在线学习提供了新范式。

papers.title: Actions Have Consequences: Detecting Outcome Performativity using Intervention Testing
papers.titleZh: 行动产生后果：通过干预测试检测结果可执行性
papers.abstract: In many domains such as Palliative Care, Credit Assignment and Recommender Systems, predictions may causally influence the outcomes they predict. This phenomena is known as Outcome Performativity. This paper formalises an approach for detecting Outcome Performativity using prediction intervention called Outcome Performativity A/B Detection (OPAB). OPAB enables the detection of Outcome Performativity by assessing the dissimilarity in outcome distributions produced by different predictions groups (interventions). If that dissimilarity is significant, Outcome Performativity is detected. We derive sample complexity bounds for OPAB under various Outcome Performative assumption classes which we empirically validate. Results show that detecting Outcome Performativity using OPAB is achievable in numerous cases. Results also show the presence of regions of indistinguishability which describe settings where the allotted number of interventions are insufficient for detecting Outcome Performativity. The results of which have broader practical implications for the detectability of Outcome Performativity in settings where samples are scarce, cost-prohibitive or potentially unethical to obtain. The paper concludes with a case study on the efficacy of OPAB on the Open Bandits dataset, and provides directions for future work.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 许多机器学习系统（如信贷审批、临终关怀）的预测会直接影响最终结果，这种现象称为‘结果可执行性’。传统方法常假设预测不影响结果，导致模型误判甚至加剧偏见。现有研究多关注已部署模型的反馈环，但缺乏在训练前识别此类效应的手段。本文旨在解决如何在离线阶段主动检测预测是否改变了真实结果分布的问题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究提出一种名为OPAB的干预测试方法，通过随机分配预测并观察实际结果分布差异来判断是否存在结果可执行性。实验基于多个真实二分类数据集，在三种假设下模拟可执行效应：简单模型、基于模型的动态和基于误分类的动态。使用卡方检验或Fisher精确检验评估组间差异，并计算不同样本量下的检测成功率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文首次形式化了通过干预检测结果可执行性的框架，并推导出各类设定下的样本复杂度边界。实验证明OPAB能在多种情况下有效识别可执行性，同时揭示了‘不可区分区域’——即当效应微弱或样本不足时无法可靠检测的情形。这为高风险领域中何时能信任预测提供了量化依据。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心思想借鉴随机对照试验，打破预测与特征间的依赖关系。通过do-intervention随机指派预测值，比较两组结果分布的统计差异。关键创新在于将因果问题转化为可检验的分布差异问题，并结合理论分析估计所需最小样本量。该方法不依赖特定模型输出，适用于数据标注阶段的前置检测。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法假设结果响应在整个特征空间均匀，现实中可能不成立；且需等待结果显现，忽略延迟反馈的影响。此外，强类别不平衡会显著降低检测效率。尽管如此，本文对理解预测系统的潜在危害极具价值，尤其推荐关注其问题设定、干预机制设计及样本复杂度分析部分。

papers.title: From Representations to Behaviors: Exploring the Person-Situation-Behavior Triad in LLMs
papers.titleZh: 从表征到行为：探索大语言模型中的个体-情境-行为三元关系
papers.abstract: Human personality theories characterize traits not as isolated attributes captured by a single score, but as stable individual tendencies expressed through the interplay among persons, situations, and behaviors. Existing studies of personality-related behavior in LLMs have primarily focused on outputs elicited under personality conditioning, characterizing observable trait-related expressions while lacking mechanistic evidence for the existence of internal personality-related representations, their cross-situational expression, and how these representations shape specific behaviors. Building on Funder's personality triad framework, we adapt its three components for LLM analysis: Person as personality-related internal representations, Situation as contexts that afford trait-relevant responses, and Behavior as response patterns on broader social tasks. We introduce a framework for discovering, controlling, and validating trait-like representations in LLMs. First, using contrastive behavior pairs grounded in shared situations, we identify sparse internal features associated with opposing poles of personality traits through SAE decomposition. We validate their trait relevance through effects on behavior to situation, token-level activation patterns, and robustness to paraphrasing. Second, feature-level interventions induce bidirectional trait-related shifts across a separate, diverse set of situations while preserving response validity, demonstrating consistent expression across contexts. Third, applying the same interventions to social intelligence tasks reveals behavioral changes with benefit-tradeoff patterns consistent with findings from human personality research, providing behavioral-level validation beyond personality scores. Our findings provide evidence that LLMs contain controllable trait-like representations linking internal states, situational expression, and behavioral outcomes.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有研究常通过提示词等方式诱导大语言模型表现出特定人格特质，但缺乏对内部是否存在稳定人格表征及其如何影响跨情境行为的机制性理解。本文关注的问题是：模型是否真具备类似人类的人格倾向，即在不同情境下表达一致的行为模式，并产生符合心理学规律的社会能力权衡。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从深层激活中提取与五大性格特质相关的稀疏特征，通过对比相同情境下高低特质反应的差异进行定位。随后在独立的情境任务集TRAIT上测试干预后的行为倾向变化，并在更广泛的社会智能评估集SocialEval上观察人际能力的收益与代价模式。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文首次建立了从内部表征到跨情境表达再到社会行为后果的完整证据链。结果显示，定向干预特定神经特征可双向调节人格相关行为，在保持响应有效性的同时，引发与人类心理学发现一致的能力权衡，如宜人性提升共情却削弱决断力，表明模型存在可控的类人格表征。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心在于利用行为对（相同情境下的高/低特质反应）提取情境不变的性格相关特征，并通过生成式干预探针筛选出因果有效的稀疏特征。其优势在于避免了传统均值向量扰动导致的语言崩溃，同时验证了表征对语义改写的鲁棒性，增强了归因可信度。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 研究依赖人工标注和专家判别，规模受限；且仅验证了五大维度，未覆盖更细粒度特质组合。尽管如此，其三元框架为理解模型行为提供了新范式，最值得阅读的是其将心理学理论形式化为可检验计算假设的方法论设计与实证路径。
